correctness.rationale: The complete formula is a direct specialization of cited chain-incidence classification: Phi_{t,alpha}(X)=(I+tE_1n)X(I-tE_1n)+(sum alpha_i x_ii)I with 1+sum alpha_i nonzero. E_1n^2=0, diagonal rank-one update has determinant r(alpha), and composition yields (t+s,alpha+r(alpha) beta). Kernel sum alpha=0 is K^{n-1}, quotient by r maps to K^*, section (c-1)e_n gives scalar semidirect action. For finite q, order q^n(q-1), q=2 elementary abelian C2^n, q>2 center order q and derived size q^{n-1}. The proof is mathematically correct within n>=3 and arbitrary field; no assertion about singular maps.
